mapper.select: SELECT id, purchase_id, order_no, apply_detail_id, asset_code, asset_name, spec, manufacturer, unit, apply_quantity, purchase_quantity, price, total_price, remark, create_time, update_time FROM asset_purchase_detail WHERE purchase_id = #{purchaseId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, purchase_id, order_no, apply_detail_id, asset_code, asset_name, spec, manufacturer, unit, apply_quantity, purchase_quantity, price, total_price, remark, create_time, update_time FROM asset_purchase_detail WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_purchase_detail (purchase_id, order_no, apply_detail_id, asset_code, asset_name, spec, manufacturer, unit, apply_quantity, purchase_quantity, price, total_price, remark) VALUES (#{purchaseId}, #{orderNo}, #{applyDetailId}, #{assetCode}, #{assetName}, #{spec}, #{manufacturer}, #{unit}, #{applyQuantity}, #{purchaseQuantity}, #{price}, #{totalPrice}, #{remark})

INSERT INTO asset_purchase_detail (purchase_id, order_no, apply_detail_id, asset_code, asset_name, spec, manufacturer, unit, apply_quantity, purchase_quantity, price, total_price, remark) VALUES
(#{item.purchaseId}, #{item.orderNo}, #{item.applyDetailId}, #{item.assetCode}, #{item.assetName}, #{item.spec}, #{item.manufacturer}, #{item.unit}, #{item.applyQuantity}, #{item.purchaseQuantity}, #{item.price}, #{item.totalPrice}, #{item.remark})
